summary_text: Tencent 2Q2026 Results: Total revenue RMB204.785B (+11% YoY), Non-IFRS operating profit RMB75.636B (+9% YoY, or +19% YoY ex-New AI drag). CapEx surged 176% YoY to RMB52.784B driving negative quarterly FCF of -RMB13.8B due to AI compute prepayments; Free Cash Flow ex-prepayment was RMB37.6B.
Tencent 1Q2026 Results: Total revenue RMB196.458B (+9% YoY), Non-IFRS operating profit RMB75.627B (+9% YoY), Free Cash Flow +RMB56.7B.
Tencent FY2025 Annual Results: Total revenue RMB751.8B, Non-IFRS operating profit RMB280.7B, CapEx RMB79.2B, Free Cash Flow RMB182.6B, and statutory share repurchases HKD80.0B.
